scope: Read-only offline audit; no new model calls or quality judgments and no original report replacement.
audit_method: Independent grouping of full native Qoder messages by session/parent/message ID, last nonzero usage snapshot replacement, native tool-result correlation, source-entry matching, ATIF/session/report comparison. No production analyzer called.

definitions.input: Qoder native input_tokens already includes cached input. Do not add cache_read_input_tokens or cache_creation_input_tokens. Sum last nonzero snapshot once per scoped message, and compare separately to final session result usage.
definitions.masked_usage: Early thinking/text/tool blocks may show all zeros; later same-message nonzero usage replaces them. A later zero block cannot erase an earlier valid snapshot.
definitions.tool_calls: All native attempts, including error results; error calls remain in their planned arm and in cost counts.
definitions.first_entry: Independent exact visible source definition or exact addressed function outline from frozen primary entry annotations; hidden raw chunks not used.
definitions.phase_boundary: Native message starts/attempts before first useful result comprise discovery, expansion follows, last answer generation is separate. Parallel batches make this an observable event partition, not proof of sequential decision causality.
definitions.temperature: No verified Qoder CLI temperature or seed control, and no provider wire capture; native model alias confirms selection, not exact hosted weights.
definitions.empty_reads: Only successful Read responses with zero visible nonwhitespace text. Failed Read calls are separately recorded, never relabelled empty success.

limitations: This single-case development experiment does not show a consistent Qoder+Qwen input-token benefit: compare signed five-block differences; retain all10 trials.
Entry localization can be faster while expansion and final-answer context costs offset its savings.
Native temperature and provider parameters are not exposed; do not claim temperature0 or deterministic reproduction.
Unknown native fields are not fabricated; no raw provider wire was available for an additional provider-level usage check.
Identity validation uses Qwen3.8-Max and qmodel_38max aliases, not a provider weight-revision fingerprint.
Quality statuses are copied as context only; another reviewer audits the calibrated two-judge evaluation.
Source/index integrity checks rely on frozen CI records; this audit did not rebuild or query the index.
